items.title: Frank Foster and Bill Hughes interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Schenectady, New York, March 28, 1995
items.q: Frank Foster currently leading the Basie orchestra on tenor and soprano sax, and Bill Hughes holding down the bass trombone chair

ctx.x: Yeah it was something else. But people don’t call me that too much anymore. Thankfully. I’ll just be happy to be called “Foss.”

Well we want to thank you gentlemen, and Frank Foster currently leading the Basie orchestra on tenor and soprano sax, and Bill Hughes holding down the bass trombone chair. It’s been a real pleasure talking to you and thanks a lot for your stories.
